arxiv_2609_00363: Deterministic LLM Inference Across GPU Kernels (arXiv:2609.00363) is not a SmolVLA paper and does not describe LeRobot preprocessing. Its measured result used here is that a tolerance of one spacing does not fire on a one-spacing fault.

cpu.qgemm: absent. The SmolVLA CPU and wgpu paths use f32 gemm_nt, not a quantized GEMM.
cpu.end_to_end_check: max abs of the faulty kernel output against the raw_actions bound
cpu.end_to_end_with_invariant_check: the raw_actions bound, or the RoPE norm and angle invariant when this kernel is RoPE
cpu.per_stage_check: the same max abs against the mapped stage bound
cpu.rope_invariant: each pair keeps its norm within sqrt(2) * gamma(5) * (|x0|+|x1|), and the recovered angle matches pos/base^(2c/dh) within gamma(5) * (1 + |theta|) radians
